hero.title: NEXT Resources
hero.headline: Keep building after NEXT.
hero.body: Free paths and selected resources to learn software, AI, hardware, robotics, IoT, design and cybersecurity.

selector.title: Choose your path
selector.body: Find your direction first. Then pick one starting resource and build something small.

catalog.title: Full catalog
catalog.body: Open only the track that fits you. Each resource has a short version and details to go deeper.

glossary.title: Concept glossary
glossary.body: Useful terms to understand the paths without getting lost in jargon.

note.title: Important note
note.body: NEXT does not issue official certifications from IBM, Google, Microsoft, Cisco, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Figma, Canva or other external platforms. NEXT guides and connects students with official or widely recognized resources. Credentials, badges or certificates are issued directly by each platform according to its own conditions, availability and requirements.

finalCta.line1: You do not need to take every course.
finalCta.line2: Choose a path. Finish one resource. Build a project. Share it.
